counting.question: How many paper numbers have a time cost greater than 10 seconds for the 'w/o Pre-computation' method?

Bana.answer: Paper numbers at 64 or higher have a time cost greater than 20 seconds for 'w/o Pre-computation'

computation.question: What is the ratio of the time cost for 'w/o Pre-computation' to 'w Pre-computation' at Paper Number 256?

comparison.question: At Paper Number 256, is the time cost for w/o Pre-computation more than 10 times the time cost for w Pre-computation?

pattern_analysis.question: How does the rate of change in time cost for the 'w/o Pre-computation' method compare to the 'w Pre-computation' method between Paper Numbers 64 and 256?

Bana.answer: The time cost for 'w Pre-computation' stays constant at 0 whilst the time cost for 'w/o Pre-computation' increases drastically
